How to read this dashboard
Counts describe the complete-case analysis dataset, which keeps only a part of the source file. Model results are research benchmarks. Rerun the notebook to refresh every figure.
Generated by this notebook from the analysis dataset and saved model results. Findings describe the selected subset and are not clinical or operational guidance.
